why: Series #1 "You asked, we answered" uses the reply-to-a-comment formula that gave the NOLA video 17.7K likes, opened with home iced-coffee footage in the style of the 67M-view at-home iced coffee Short. The goal is to show a real barista recipe and invite viewers to write on WhatsApp.
